style: Original hand-painted dark fantasy item icons with chunky readable silhouettes, painted volume, dark vignetted backgrounds and selective colored magic accents.
sourceDesignsAvailability: Historical local input at generation time; not required by the importer and not included in this icon asset commit. Its source options are embedded in the cells below.
cellOrder: row-major, left to right, top to bottom
optionsEncoding: Literal source DESIGNS options; tuples are JSON arrays. tinted(...) becomes an object with kind, rgb, finish and named flags.
recipeAppearance: Derive from the finished sourceId artwork with a small clearly distinct recipe seal; keep the main item readable.
levelAppearance: Keep each family silhouette. Mark levels I and II with an unobtrusive, readable corner badge; level II may add a restrained glow accent.
